name: Micah
summary: A prophet from Moresheth to whom the word of the LORD came in the days of Jotham, Ahaz and Hezekiah, kings of Judah. He spoke against the sins of Samaria and Jerusalem and told what the LORD requires.

key_moments.title: Warns Zion Will Be Plowed Like a Field
key_moments.description: Micah told the rulers that they judged for bribes, and the priests and prophets worked for money while saying no evil could come. Because of them, he said, Zion would be plowed like a field and Jerusalem would become heaps.

key_moments.title: Says Swords Will Become Plowshares
key_moments.description: Micah said that in the last days many nations would go up to the mountain of the LORD to learn His ways. They would beat their swords into plowshares, and every man would sit under his vine and fig tree with none to make him afraid.

key_moments.title: Says Do Justly, Love Mercy, Walk Humbly
key_moments.description: Micah asked what a man should bring before the LORD: burnt offerings, thousands of rams, even his firstborn? He answered that the LORD had shown what is good: to do justly, love mercy and walk humbly with God.
